text:
maria: Heads up — I'm about to scale up the gpu-pool-us-west2 to add 4 NV6 instances for a latency spike mitigation. Pre-merge OPA/Conftest is blocking the plan (policy: no unattended pool changes during midnight maintenance window). Can we get a short exemption or an alternative rollback-safe path?
akash: what changed in the plan? can we do a canary first (1 node) and monitor KV cache hit + tail latency? :thinking_face:
maria: plan is simple:
```
module "gpu_pool" {
  count = 1
  size  = 4
  type  = "nv6"
}
```
we need capacity ASAP — client incident 8342 ongoing.
jen: infra-bot shows OPA fail: `policy/gpu_pool_maintenance_block` — requires approvals and a CSV of business justification. Did you fill the deployment ticket? link: https://tickets/redwood/8342
maria: I filed ticket but asked for faster route. I can add the justification: "restore tail latency for realtime infer pipelines, incident 8342" — but still need 2 approvers per policy.
infra-bot: OPA check failed: `gpu_pool_maintenance_block` — details: maintenance_window=00:00-06:00, change_time=1893456789, approvers_required=2
akash: two quick options: 1) request exemption via ops-exemptions (slower) 2) apply a canary change as a separate resource tagged `canary=true` and scale up only 1 node outside the blocked modification path. That would pass Conftest because it's a new resource.
maria: canary sounds good. What's the terraform snippet to create a canary pool?
jen: try:
```
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "canary_nv6" {
  name  = "gpu-pool-us-west2-canary"
  count = 1
  type  = "nv6"
  tags  = ["canary", "incident-8342"]
}
```
then validate plan and smoke test with curl to /health on local envoy.
samir: if we do canary, add autoscale.min=1, autoscale.max=4 to avoid unexpected burst. also add node taint `taint=canary:NoSchedule` so prod workloads don't jump.
maria: applying now. will paste plan output.
infra-bot: terraform plan check: resources to add: 1 redwood_gpu_pool.canary_nv6; OPA checks: PASSED for new_resource_policy, FAILED for global_maintenance_policy (but only blocking modify/delete). Full output attached.
akash: good — since it's an add, we should be OK. jen: monitor token cost, but urgent.
maria: applied. smoke tests: latency dropped 18% tail for the affected route. attaching logs.
jen: nice. maria — please open a short post-action runbook: how we tested, timeline, and rollback steps.
maria: will do. samir approved in thread: :thumbsup:. jen approved: :thumbsup:
akash: marking this as temporary exemption path. ops team — please follow up to request formal policy exemption for the wider pool change during the next maintenance window.
maria: thanks all. closing the incident for now, will submit follow-up RFC.
